_comment: Canonical Datakam/OpenSpeedcam TYPE code mapping — Stage 2 WIP source mapping. NOT Product Canon.
_doc: See docs/research/datakam-openspeedcam-type-mapping.md for full rationale, QA observations, and data policy.
_policy: This mapping is trusted for Stage 2 emulator work because it was previously implemented and manually checked in the Datakam QA viewer (web/datakam-viewer). It is not Product Canon, not legal truth, and not safety-certified data.

entries.notes: Fixed point speed/enforcement camera. Observed in Rostov1 evaluation data.
Traffic-light camera. Normalized to static_camera for emulator POC V1 scope.
Red-light camera. Normalized to static_camera for emulator POC V1 scope. Observed in Rostov1 evaluation data.
Average-speed (section) camera. Normalized to static_camera for emulator POC V1 scope.
Mobile speed camera. Normalized to static_camera for emulator POC V1 scope.
Pedestrian crossing. Normalized to road_bump (hazard category) for emulator POC V1 scope. Observed in Rostov1 evaluation data.

Speed-regime / speed-limit sign. In manually inspected examples this type includes both ordinary speed-limit signs and settlement signs that imply a default speed regime (e.g. 60 km/h). Treat as a speed-regime candidate, not necessarily a literal standalone speed-limit sign. Observed in Rostov1 evaluation data.
Speed bump / road bump. Bidirectional rows (DIRTYPE=2) are expected and appear correct — bumps span the road. Multiple rows may share the same coordinates. Observed in Rostov1 evaluation data.
Bad road / road surface hazard. Normalized to road_bump (hazard category) for emulator POC V1 scope. Observed in Rostov1 evaluation data.
Dangerous turn / curve. Normalized to road_bump (hazard category) for emulator POC V1 scope. Observed in Rostov1 evaluation data.
Dangerous intersection. Normalized to road_bump (hazard category) for emulator POC V1 scope.

Other danger / hazard. In at least one manual QA observation this type appeared as a railway crossing. Source label other_danger is preserved; railway crossing is a documented observed subtype/example. Observed in Rostov1 evaluation data.

direction_semantics_note: DIRECTION often appears to represent sign/camera facing direction rather than vehicle travel direction. Candidate vehicle travel direction may be approximately (DIRECTION + 180) mod 360, but this remains WIP source-semantics evidence, not Canon.
raw_data_policy: Raw speedcam.txt files remain local and gitignored. Prepared bounded route-scoped outputs (e.g. Rostov1.events.json) may be committed only when explicitly approved and confirmed to contain no raw source rows.
